decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to prune the subject twenty-two (22) trees, which are subject to TPO Ref. TPO/56C/4/76, shall only comprise of the works outlined within Appendix 1 of the Preliminary Tree Condition Survey (dated 14th July 2026) prepared by Artemis Tree Services and must be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998:2010.

To preserve the health of the existing trees and visual amenity of the surrounding area, in accordance with Policies DC8 and OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 2 - No less than five working days' notice shall be given to the Council's Aboricultural Officer before any work commences to the trees (Telephone 020 8748 3020). In order that the Council has the opportunity to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with Condition 1, in accordance with Policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).
